cell_line.evidence: HEK293 cells were grown in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 1% Penicillin/streptomycin and L-glutamine (2mM) (Biological industries) at 37°C with 5% CO2.
To induce exhaustion, the A375 melanoma cell-line was treated with IFN-γ (200U/ml) for 24 hours and co-cultured with the stimulated T-cells in a 1:2 ratio, respectively, for 4 days.

cell_type.evidence: Primary human CD8+ T cells were separated from healthy leucocyte samples, obtained from Blood Service Center (MDA, Israel), by centrifugation over Lymphoprep (Axis-Shield) and positive selection using CD8+ magnetic microbeads (Milteny Biotic).
PBMC fractions were purified from approximately 60ml of whole blood using Sepmate (StemCell Technologies) and immediately frozen in liquid nitrogen.
